feature: Structured Outputs / Function Calling Strict Mode (base models)
notes: These rules apply to base models. Fine-tuned models have additional restrictions.

rules.description: Every object must have additionalProperties set to false
rules.doc_quote: All fields or function parameters must be specified as required. [...] additionalProperties: false
rules.fix: Set "additionalProperties": false on all object schemas

rules.description: All properties in an object must be listed in required array
rules.doc_quote: All fields must be required: To use Structured Outputs, all fields or function parameters must be specified as required.
rules.check: required array must contain all keys from properties
rules.fix: Add all property keys to the "required" array, or use union with null to emulate optional

rules.description: allOf is not supported in strict mode
rules.doc_quote: Some type-specific keywords are not yet supported: Composition: allOf, not, dependentRequired, dependentSchemas, if, then, else
rules.fix: Remove allOf or merge schemas manually

rules.description: not is not supported in strict mode
rules.doc_quote: Some type-specific keywords are not yet supported: Composition: allOf, not, dependentRequired, dependentSchemas, if, then, else

rules.description: dependentRequired is not supported in strict mode
rules.doc_quote: Some type-specific keywords are not yet supported: Composition: allOf, not, dependentRequired, dependentSchemas, if, then, else

rules.description: dependentSchemas is not supported in strict mode
rules.doc_quote: Some type-specific keywords are not yet supported: Composition: allOf, not, dependentRequired, dependentSchemas, if, then, else

rules.description: if/then/else conditional schemas are not supported in strict mode
rules.doc_quote: Some type-specific keywords are not yet supported: Composition: allOf, not, dependentRequired, dependentSchemas, if, then, else

rules.description: anyOf cannot appear at the root schema
rules.doc_quote: Root objects must not be anyOf and must be an object: the root level object of a schema must be an object, and not use anyOf.
rules.check: anyOf at root level not allowed
rules.fix: Wrap anyOf in an object schema
